resources.string: Hold the card near your phone NFC antenna. Some contactless bank cards are supported.
This device does not support NFC.
Turn on NFC in system settings first.
Unlock Monica, then tap the card again.
This card has no readable bank card number. Protected identity cards are not supported; a chip UID is not a card number.
Could not read the card. Hold it near the phone and try again.
A bank card was read, but this page is for another item type. Open a new bank card page? Your current content will be kept.
The scanned details differ from the form. Only the card number, expiry and cardholder details provided by the card will be replaced. Other content will be kept.
Card details were read. NFC cannot reliably identify credit, debit or prepaid cards. Please confirm the type.
Scanned card details filled in. Review them before saving.
Finish the current operation before scanning a card.
